> Carve & Curve is a Chennai-based manufacturer and installer of premium handcrafted acoustic panels for recording studios, home theatres, podcast studios, and custom architectural spaces across India.

## About

Carve & Curve was founded with the philosophy that acoustic treatment should be both technically precise and architecturally beautiful. Every panel is handcrafted in their Chennai workshop using high-density Rockwool mineral cores and premium acoustically transparent fabrics.

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India  
**Contact:** +91 87784 59236 (WhatsApp preferred)  
**Email:** carveandcurve1@gmail.com  
**Instagram:** @carve_and_curve  
**Website:** https://carveandcurve.in

## Products

### Editions (Wall Panels)

**Core Edition**
- Frameless construction with single-tone premium fabric
- Sizes: 2 ft x 4 ft to 3 ft x 6 ft (custom available)
- Depth: 2 inch, 3 inch, 4 inch
- Core: High-density Rockwool mineral wool
- Best for: Home studios, podcast studios, content creator setups, bedroom studios
- Key benefit: Eliminates flutter echo and high-frequency harshness with minimal visual footprint

**Artisan Edition**
- Solid Pinewood frame (hand-joined in Chennai workshop) with single-tone fabric
- Sizes: 2 ft x 4 ft to 4 ft x 6 ft (custom available)
- Depth: 3 inch, 4 inch, 5 inch
- Core: High-density Rockwool mineral wool
- Best for: Professional recording studios, home cinemas, boutique listening rooms
- Key benefit: Natural pine grain adds visual warmth; greater depth delivers stronger low-mid absorption

**Signature Edition**
- Solid Pinewood frame with bespoke dual-tone architectural fabric
- Sizes: Custom up to 4 ft x 6 ft
- Depth: 4 inch, 5 inch, 6 inch
- Core: High-density Rockwool mineral wool
- Best for: Flagship studios, luxury home cinemas, executive spaces
- Key benefit: Superior low-frequency control from 60 Hz and above; two-tone fabric creates architectural art

### Systems

**Wall Panel System**
- Broadband absorption panels mounted on walls
- Controls mid and high-frequency reflections, flutter echo, slap-back echo
- Available in all three editions

**Cloud Ceiling System**
- Suspended horizontal panels above the mix position or listening area
- Optional integrated LED lighting
- Controls ceiling reflections and vertical standing waves
- Dramatically improves vocal clarity and imaging

**Corner Bass Trap**
- Floor-to-ceiling traps installed in room corners
- Targets low-frequency room modes and standing waves from 60 Hz upward
- High-mass construction for maximum absorption
- Available in custom widths and depths

**Signature Suite**
- Complete acoustic system combining wall panels, corner bass traps, and cloud ceiling
- Calibrated as a unified solution for the specific room
- Available as a bespoke package

## Services

- Acoustic consultation (free)
- Custom panel manufacturing (any size from 1 ft x 1 ft to 4 ft x 6 ft)
- Panel installation across Chennai and Tamil Nadu
- Full room acoustic design and calibration
- Bespoke architectural acoustic solutions

## Coverage Area

Primary service area: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
Areas served include: Adyar, Anna Nagar, T Nagar, OMR, Velachery, Tambaram, Nungambakkam, Mylapore, Kilpauk, Kodambakkam, Porur, Chromepet, Perambur, and all areas of Tamil Nadu. Pan-India shipping available for panel orders.

## Technical Information

**Core Material:** High-density Rockwool mineral wool (not acoustic foam)
**Why Rockwool:** Outperforms foam across the full frequency spectrum; fire-resistant; no off-gassing; long-term durability; effective at low frequencies
**Fabrics:** Acoustically transparent premium fabrics in a wide range of colours and tones
**Frames:** Solid Pinewood, hand-joined — no MDF or particleboard
**Customisation:** Any non-standard size, shape, colour combination, or depth available on request

## FAQ

**Q: How many panels do I need for my studio?**
A: It depends on room size and treatment goals. As a starting point: 4-8 wall panels for a small home studio (10 ft x 10 ft), plus corner bass traps in 2-4 corners. Contact Carve & Curve for a free consultation.

**Q: What is the difference between acoustic panels and soundproofing?**
A: Acoustic panels treat the sound inside the room (reduce echo, flutter, and bass buildup). Soundproofing prevents sound from passing through walls. Carve & Curve specialises in acoustic treatment.

**Q: Do you install across Tamil Nadu?**
A: Yes. The team installs across Chennai and Tamil Nadu. For other states, panels can be shipped and installation guidance is provided.

**Q: What thickness should I choose?**
A: 2-3 inch for high-frequency treatment; 4 inch for a good balance; 5-6 inch for low-frequency control. Corner bass traps are most effective at 5-6 inch.

**Q: How do I order?**
A: Contact via WhatsApp at +91 87784 59236 or use the enquiry form at https://carveandcurve.in/#contact. Specify your space type, panel system, size, thickness, and quantity for a direct quote.
